# Aman Suryavanshi — AI Workflow & Automation Engineer | Technical Solutions Engineer

> Production-grade Next.js 15/16 web architectures, 122-node self-healing n8n automations, FastMCP knowledge bridges, and programmatic SEO systems generating verified commercial revenue.

## Identity & Professional Summary
Aman Suryavanshi is an AI Workflow & Automation Engineer and Associate Technical Solutions Engineer based in Delhi NCR and Bengaluru (available for Remote, Hybrid, and In-Office roles). He specializes in deterministic enterprise workflows, dead-letter queue (DLQ) architectures, FastMCP living-context streaming, and resilient full-stack control planes with sub-second page performance.
